text: Large curd cubes, a light pressing and a short brining keep this cheese high in moisture. A brief cold ripening of three to four weeks leaves a soft, closed, slightly elastic paste with no eyes and a mildly acidic taste.

steps.note: The curd is put into a block or flat cylinder of 2–5 kg.
The cheese is ripened for at least 20 days if it is up to 2.5 kg, and 30 days if 2.5–5 kg.
